zh-CN.title: 升级仪式全面焕新
items: 升级改为庆祝、奖励揭晓和下一级预告三幕全屏流程
等级数字与成长进度通过动态效果完成跃迁

en.title: A new three-act level-up ceremony
items: Level-ups now unfold across celebration, reward reveal, and next-level preview screens
Animated level numbers and progress make every milestone feel earned
Five growth stages and every reward category now have distinct visual identities
